notes: SAP-Commerce site (same platform family as XXXLutz DE, confirmed by prior Home-Decor pass in notes/129.md). Access route: www.moemax.de sits behind a Cloudflare JS challenge that blocks plain requests/WebFetch; resolved via curl_cffi browser impersonation (chrome124 profile succeeded on first try for this session). Pet Care search method: fetched sitemap-categories.xml (655KB, full category tree with breadcrumb-coded C<id> slugs) and grepped for German pet-related keywords (hund/katze/haustier/tierbedarf/tierbett/napf/kratzbaum/leine/halsband/kaefig/welpen/tierkorb/katzenklo). Found exactly one pet-specific node: 'alle-tierbedarf-C41C2' (Tierbedarf = Pet Supplies) under the 'Freizeit' (Leisure) top-level section (C41). No child URLs exist under C41C2 in the sitemap (checked C41C2* prefix, only the one leaf found) -- it is a single flat leaf category, not a grouping node. Fetched the category page directly and confirmed via SSR JSON (pageSize=60, totalPages=1, totalResults=16) and the rendered listing-bar text '16 von 16 Artikel angezeigt' -- exhaustion check ceil(16/60)=1==1 passes. Product-name sample pulled from the page JSON confirms genuine pet-care contents: 5x Kratzbaum (cat scratching tree/post), Hundesofa (dog sofa/bed), Hundestrandkorb (dog basket/bed), Haustierkissen (pet cushion) -- all Tier-1 in-scope product types (beds/sleeping, scratching posts). Ruled out 'alle-kuscheltiere-C41C1C4C1'-style Kuscheltiere (cuddly/plush toys) as children's toys under Spielzeug (C41C1), not pet products -- excluded per Tier-1/Tier-2 boundary (toy for a child, not for a pet). Two apparent regex hits on 'kleinen'/'kleinelektro' were false positives (substring 'leine' inside 'kleinen') and not real pet-leash categories -- verified by inspecting the actual URLs (small corner sofas, small kitchen appliances), no further pet content there. No other pet-specific nav branches found anywhere else in the 3000+-URL sitemap (Garden, Home Accessories, Furniture sections checked via the same keyword grep, all negative). Absence of further Pet Care depth is therefore proven by full sitemap keyword sweep, not by site search.
